headline: Maya Renaissance project investment exceeding 151,000 mdp in Yucatán
summary: Yucatán's strategic projects are expected to generate more than 79,000 direct and indirect jobs through infrastructure works, energy development and industrial promotion. Planned investment is above 151,000 million pesos.
why: State-level infrastructure and industrial investment programmes affect construction demand, energy projects and employment in Mexican regions.
original_headline: Proyecta Renacimiento Maya inversión superior a 151,000 mdp en Yucatán
